neighbours.label: last word of an institution's proper name (… Research Institute, Institute of … Studies, … Institution)
fire: The survey was carried out by economists at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy last spring.
She spent two years as a visiting scholar at the Institute for Advanced Studies in Vienna.
The figures were compiled by the Peterson Institute and checked by two outside reviewers.
He directs a small team at the Francis Crick Institute in central London.
The fossils were sent to the Smithsonian Institution for cleaning and dating.
Her paper appeared in a volume edited by the School of Oriental and African Studies.
The vaccine trial was run jointly with the Pasteur Institute in Paris.
The grant was awarded to the Salk Institute to continue the work on ageing.
quiet: The survey was carried out by a few economists who met every week last spring.
She spent two years as a visiting scholar in Vienna before returning home.
The figures were compiled by hand and checked by two outside reviewers.
He directs a small team of biologists in central London.
The fossils were sent abroad for cleaning and dating.
Her paper appeared in a volume about languages spoken along the coast.
The vaccine trial was run jointly with several hospitals in Paris.
The grant was awarded to continue the work on ageing for three more years.

notes: Card flags this pole broad (6.2% of tokens reach 0.1 of max) and gate-closed (echo regime 100%, max only 0.88): ',' x6, ' Institute' x3, ' China' x2. Probes: 'Institute of Fiscal Studies' 1.0, 'Research Institute' 0.71, 'Institution' 0.42, but also generic ' laboratory' 0.39, ' family' 0.37, ',' after China 0.37, ' office' 0.21. Near misses keep the research topic with generic lower-case workplaces, so they may well leak; the test records how selective the institution-name reading is.
